digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow infrastructure — Gerrit Verify lane routing and documentation validation
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must select a reduced verification lane containing only documentation-related gates (ADR/index/cross-reference, docs build, README quickstart, drift validation) while skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs.

The routing decision (docs-only vs full) must execute exclusively from trusted origin/main with classifier logic and allowlist never imported from the patchset; only the exact change name-only diff crosses as untrusted data.

Any non-allowlisted path (Python, shell, executable, workflows, dependencies, locks, tests, fixtures, config, unknown, or unavailable diffs) must deterministically select full Verify with fail-closed semantics; classifier failure or malformed input must trigger full fallback and block Verified +1.

Shared documentation validation gates must be extracted into a single composite action definition with no inline copies; all structural test consumers of _build-and-test.yml must migrate without weakening invariants.
Classifier job and docs-only job outputs must wire through vote.needs so exactly one route executes, skipped jobs are neutral, and a failed classifier blocks Verified even when full-route jobs pass.
Production docs-only and full routes must be live-tested on genuine changes with runner-minute and wall-clock timing recorded against baseline run 31817494677.
